rules.text: The Pain Is Real: a damaging Action Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu becomes a Genjutsu (loses those keywords, gains Genjutsu and Tactile).

castOption.label: Onijutsu: The Pain Is Real (2 Oni-Coils)
castOption.note: It becomes a Genjutsu with Tactile (it loses its Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu keywords).

system.description: At the cost of 2 Oni-Coils, when you cast a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu that deals damage as an Action, you can convert it into a Genjutsu. The Jutsu cast loses its Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu keywords, gaining the Genjutsu and Tactile keywords.
